correctness.rationale: The proof establishes strict convexity on individually weighted connected simple graphs, uses exact core Laplacian eigenspaces and bridge series law to derive the Kirchhoff objective, applies Cauchy–Schwarz with a verified feasible equality case for low chord price, and verifies the boundary KKT inequality for large price; equality and uniqueness are included. Fixed-leaf asymptotic follows from the exact normalization. The included standalone exact-rational Laplacian program ran successfully with 1680 finite checks, which are supplementary only.

value.rationale: The full solved all-budget all-price conductance design on a natural clique-with-pendant community graph identifies when redundant clique links have positive optimal mass, the exact unique allocation and optimal value, an unexpected cutoff depending only on total network order, and a limiting efficiency ratio min(t/2,1). It is a complete nontrivial natural graph-family optimization rather than a fixed finite numeric instance, and the result does not claim general optimization machinery as new.
